items.q: I had a good bit of training from a former member of the Philadelphia Orchestra.

ctx.x: No, my first experience with truly symphonic work began in the '40's with the Height Symphony and I had a good bit of training from a former member of the Philadelphia Orchestra. He used to be an oboe player with the Philadelphia Orchestra, Maxim Waldo, and he was the conductor of the Height Symphony, and I went there twice a week.
